title: HSK2 Gate 8 · Three Kingdoms
explanationEn: Gate 8: Three Kingdoms. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第8关：三国。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 汉朝以后，中国分成了三个国家。这三个国常常打来打去。那时候有一个很聪明的人，叫诸葛亮。他年轻的时候住在山里，天天看书。
passageEn: After the Han, China split into three states. The three states fought one another constantly. There was a very clever man of that time called Zhuge Liang. When he was young he lived in the hills and read every day.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: After the Han, China split into three states.
comprehension.answer: 汉朝以后，中国分成了三个国家。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: There was a very clever man of that time called Zhuge Liang.
comprehension.answer: 那时候有一个很聪明的人，叫诸葛亮。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 汉朝 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“汉朝”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 汉朝 (Hàncháo) means "Han Dynasty" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “汉朝”（Hàncháo）的意思是“Han Dynasty”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 以后 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“以后”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 以后 (yǐ hòu) means "after" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “以后”（yǐ hòu）的意思是“after”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 汉朝以后，中国分成了三个国家。

options.text: Because there was so much rain, the water rose higher and higher.
The water came into the fields, and into many people’s homes.
After the Han, China split into three states.
Very long ago, it rained in China for many days.

check.explanationEn: "汉朝以后，中国分成了三个国家。" means "After the Han, China split into three states.".
check.explanation: “汉朝以后，中国分成了三个国家。”的意思是“After the Han, China split into three states.”。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Three Kingdoms in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说三国。
